svg.title: Backups and a full export — SoftTrack web design mockup (#311)
svg.desc: An instance’s data is in the database and in the attachments, and the deployment guide does not mention backing either up. The documentation says what to back up and how to restore; a script writes one archive of both and its opposite restores it; and a site admin can export everything from the app, without password hashes, tokens and secrets, while a team admin can export their team.
svg.text: What a team takes with it, and what an instance does

Done when docs/deployment.md says what to back up, in which order and how to restore for Postgres and SQLite with local and S3 attachments; backup.py writes one archive of
both and restore.py refuses to overwrite an instance with data unless told to; a restore is tested in CI; a site admin can export everything as JSON per table plus attachments, built
in the background, without hashes, tokens and secrets; a team admin can export their team; and every export is recorded.
